messages:
Maya (Partnerships): Hardware partner asked for an evidence bundle for marketplace listing: SOC2 cover page, redacted pen-test, vendor attestation. Deadline = 8 days. Who takes point?
Omar (Security): I can own the pen-test intake and redaction. Do they need a CVE CSV or narrative?
Pete (Marketplace): CVE CSV preferred, plus mitigations.csv and scope.txt (products + regions). Also require a signed attestation PDF and checksum.sha256 at top level.
Clara (Legal): I'll drop the attestation template here and confirm required redaction language. No customer PII in uploads.
Jin (Eng): I'll run the automated scrub + manual review, generate findings.csv and checksum, then create a presigned URL for the zip. Example: aws s3 presign s3://evidence/outbound/marketplace/hw_partner_456_2026-05-03.zip --expires-in 604800
Omar (Security): Redaction checklist: remove emails, phone numbers, internal hostnames, customer identifiers, screenshots with customer data. Require second reviewer sign-off.
Maya (Partnerships): Action owners: Omar = vendor follow-up + redact; Jin = run job + presign/upload; Clara = attestation language + signature. I'll draft the external note once artifacts are ready.
evidence-bot: Created ticket EVID-6221 assigned to Omar, Jin, Clara.
